key_insight: MyTm automates melting-temperature prediction from molecular dynamics by modularizing several standard melting-point methods and adding ML-based atom classification for robust high-throughput use.
engineering_relevance: It reduces the manual effort and bottlenecks in computational materials screening, enabling faster autonomous estimation of melting temperatures for candidate materials.
method: Implements a modular MD toolkit that supports direct-heating, void, modified void, solid-liquid coexistence, and Z-method workflows.
Uses a machine learning classifier to distinguish solid-like and liquid-like atoms more accurately than conventional rules.
Orchestrates the full melting-point calculation pipeline for automated, high-throughput execution.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that robustness and efficacy were demonstrated on several well-studied systems.
watch_item: Performance will depend on the quality of the ML atom classification and careful setup of the chosen MD melting method for each material.
paper_title: MyTm: An Automated Melting Temperature Calculation Toolkit
